issues.detail: Hebrew 'עָשׁ' (Ash) is a star/constellation name, but Vietnamese renders it as 'sao Bắc Đẩu' (Big Dipper/Ursa Major), which is a different identification. 'כְסִיל' (Kesil) is rendered 'sao Tam Giác' (Triangulum), but Kesil is typically Orion; 'כִימָה' (Kimah) is rendered 'sao Sư Tử' (Leo), but Kimah is usually Pleiades. These are name swaps for astronomical terms.
